reviews.title: Terrible service. No English-speaking customer service.
reviews.text: Terrible service. Flight 4.5 hours late because of weather conditions. I had a connecting flight but there was no question of finding me an alternative flight. No one there could speak English and customer service agents were rude. I did not make my connecting flight and lost non-refundable hotel bookings and two connecting flights because of this airline. If anything goes wrong, you should know this airline will NOT help you.
reviews.author: Alleoisa Offermann

reviews.title: They charge you twice for one flight
reviews.text: They charged us twice for one flight and when we asked for a refund it was refused. Terrible customer service as we asked multiple times and the refund was never processed.
reviews.author: punkachump

reviews.title: Flying with brand-new B-787
reviews.text: This is the second time I fly with onboard a B-787 of Juneyao Airlines. Comfortable flight with the very clean cabin despite the flight was full.
reviews.author: Victor H

reviews.title: Good Value in Business Class
reviews.text: The time of the flight was 10:00am. No airline branding at check-inn counters, common user zone.. Airline checked United Airlines frequent flyer for milage with Juneyao. (great!) VIP lounge not worth it! Airbus A320. 8 in business class. Good meal services for this flight - hots meal provided even for a mid morning departure. 1 hr & 45 minutes on flight time. Drink menu given before departing. No inflight entertainment. Service good. Arrived on time. Overall very good value for money.
reviews.author: Phillip B

reviews.title: Refuse to refund
reviews.text: My troubles with Juneyao Airlines were numerous. I wouldn't recommend this airline to anyone. 1. I tried to book a flight Helsinki-Zhenzghou through their website in October. Although they note that you can pay with Visa or Mastercard, they don't accept those cards. Because of that, upon their own advice, I booked through Trip.com, and had to pay 100 euros more than if I were to book through their website. 2. I was supposed to fly in November. However, China suddenly changed the rules of entering the country because of Covid-19 and I had to reschedule my flight for February. Juneyao published on their website that they will waive their fee for changing the date because of this. I contacted Trip.com who assured me 3 times that the fee waiver is not applicable to my case so I paid 167 eur fee in order to reschedule the flight. 3. In February I had to finally cancel my flight and Juneyao promised to refund the entire fare. When I inquired will they refund just the flight price or both flight price and the 167 eur fee that I had to pay for rescheduling, Juneyao informed me that Trip.com charged the fee without ever consulting with them and that I never needed to pay that fee. They assured me they will refund the 167 eur fee as well. 4. During the 3 weeks of constant emailing between me, Juneyao and Trip.com, I was assured by Juneyao customer service in at least 4 emails that they will refund the 167 eur fee. However, after I received the refund of my original ticket, I asked Juneyao when can I expect the refund since they told me that the refund is in progress, Juneyao representative told me that they checked again (which time?!) and now they came to the conclusion that I had to pay for that fee after all! To make things more complicated, I received an email from Trip.com that Juneyao indeed will refund 167 eur and that they are waiting for them to transfer the money. 5. Being very frustrated by all of this, I asked Juneyao to make an exception and refund the 167 eur fee even though perhaps I indeed had to pay, because they've been assuring me for 3 weeks that they will refund. They stopped replying to my emails, and after I started posting reviews about my experience, they offered me a voucher for extra luggage. I refused since I never plan to travel with that extremely unprofessional airline again.
reviews.author: Sasha

reviews.title: Serious issues with airline service and medical testing
reviews.text: I flew on Finnair from Tallinn to Helsinki and on Juneyao Air from Helsinki to Shanghai on a business/academic trip. Several problems cropped up with Juneyao Air. The overnight stay at the Helsinki Airport was 24+ hours, but no accommodations (eg, food and blankets) were provided, even though the airport hotel was closed for transit passengers. The Covid-19 testing, for which the airline charged 350+ euros and which was a repeat of tests already done in Estonia, was unprofessional: the nurse poked around for a vein and blood splashed. Finally, even though I had a boarding pass and two sets of negative test results, along with a green health code from the Chinese government, my boarding was delayed, apparently in retaliation for asking questions. I think that the Helsinki airport (operated by Finavia) and other authorities should investigate the business and medical practices of Juneyao Air in Finland and take appropriate action.
reviews.author: Scholar

reviews.title: New 2 aisle aircraft
reviews.text: Both flights Shanghai-Sanya and Sanya-Shanghai were onboard a 787 aircraft, the new addition to Juneyao fleet. The model and the new aircraft made the over 2h40 trips more comfortable. The constraints of the covid-19 pandemic made regular services and offerings unavailable but the crew were polite and smiling. Service was overall professional except at the check-in count at Shanghai Hongqiao Airport where the staff were confused about foreign nationals not having a national health code that can be only registered with a PRC ID card while security control knew to check on other apps validated by the People's National Congress.
reviews.author: Victor H

reviews.title: Extreme stupidity combined with laziness
reviews.text: My friend and I booked this flight through Trip.com, which has a max limit on how many letters are allowed in your name when booking through the website or app. We contacted juneyao airlines via email since that was the only way possible, to ask them what we had to do to make sure we were definitely going to be allowed to check in to the flights given that our names were written incompletely, as we both have long given and middle names. This brilliant customer service representative responded to my email by saying that we might not be able to get on the flight, as it will be subject to whoever is checking us in at the airport and what they decide to do. I raised hell Karen-style and responded very nastily, and finally got a response from someone competent who decided to do their job by telling us that they'd resolve the issue for us and that we would have no problem getting on the flight. It got resolved but not as it should have the first go around. This, obviously, was an issue.
reviews.author: Samantha T

reviews.title: Almost but no cigar
reviews.text: The flight leaves at 15:30 and gets to Shanghai at 6:30am. The boarding was fairly standard, nothing specific. The airline ticketing system is not integrated with OneWorld so AY was not able to issue onward tickets. This in turn made it complicated to go through security (try it without boarding passes) in Helsinki, but we made it - kudos to the border police at HEL. Nonetheless, the airline was quick to issue tickets at the gate which was appreciated. Online check-in was not available, which is always a hassle - we apparently got the last available three seats together. The flight was uneventful. You will be served twice during the flight - a small dinner two hours into the flight and a sandwich 1.5h before arrival. Both meals were small, but the flight crew was happy to give me an extra meal later (very rare). The windows could be electronically dimmed and the entertainment system was bright, clear and responsive. Negatives: OES did hang up a few times, it turned on the display whenever there was an announcement and the selection of movies/TV was limited. Legroom was ok and the staff was courteous. I'm tall (6'4) and to be comfy I tend to keep my knee in the aisle, so I almost always get it banged up by the food tray. The staff took extra care with me, which I very much appreciated. All in all, some more meals, better OES selection and integration with other airlines would really improve them a lot. Still, they were the cheapest available and they got me there on time, so not too bad.
reviews.author: Mikoraud

reviews.title: Great Value on Travel in East Asia
reviews.text: To qualify for visa exemptions in China, we had to leave the country and return. We opted to take a quick flight from Shanghai to Hong Kong on Lunar New Year, which meets the Chinese government's criteria for this type of visa exemption. I selected JuneYao Air based almost entirely on the price, which was well below what I would expect a similar flight to cost at home in the United States. For that price, our flight proved to be an incredible value. Despite being a very short trip, we received complementary snack boxes. The seats were very comfortable and the flight crew, who spoke English very well, were friendly and helpful. I did not have any experience with their customer service department or any problems with my flight. I also did not utilize them for a true international flight, so I cannot speak to that experience. For local flights within China (or to autonomous Chinese regions), I would absolutely fly JuneYao air again.
reviews.author: Devin B

reviews.title: Flying with Kids
reviews.text: Have used the airline a couple of times and have been good and ok. The timing of the flight if perfect for families with kids. The plane and the seat with good foot space are very good. However, the food on board and the entertainment options need improvement. For young children, there are four books on the screen that takes 5 min to read. So need to get my own books and toys to keep baby entertained. More options for younger children is welcome. The staff is very friendly and flexible. The food needs a significant update because a couple of times before I have brought my own food onboard as back up option. Both times have been happy that I did.
reviews.author: Kari Hakala

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: When I had to cancel my flight I applied for a refund however, they would always put me on hold. One time the operator hung up on me even though I could hear him talking to someone else on the line. This is by far the worst service I have received in all my years of traveling.
reviews.author: Kirk

reviews.title: My personal favorite airliner
reviews.text: I did not expect that but I find this airliner perfect for me. From floor to roof and from stepping to plane till leaving it everything work at least good. Service was very neat and for dinner there were western and Chinese option. Staff kept plane clean all the time and none of them had any bad manners. First time on flight I could actully hear all announcements from the captain and from the cabin crew. Also entertainment system works was and has high quality screen and dozens of new Chinese movies (with English subtitles) and some western as well. Some problems are that when flight attendant ask what food do you want, he just asked: rice or noodle... well it was macaroni box not noodle! I asked him to change for Chinese option: rice with fish with my weak Chinese and it worked (some flight attendants speak good English but not all). Also at the airport some staff only know how to behave with Chinese people with Chinese language, when they need to speak English with foreigner they seem confused and rude, but it was only couple people.
reviews.author: 260nikok

reviews.title: No problems
reviews.text: We booked this route Pudong to Phuket rather last minute and were nervous about transferring in Pudong and flying an airline we had never heard of. The transition was easy. The counter service was efficient and good. There were no delays in either direction. In fact we landed early both times. There is a good luggage allowance and a snack or meal was served each way. The seating was on par with American domestic flights. While I hated flying in the middle of the night, it was the only way to make the trip work so we did it and it went fine. The pilots in both directions were Western. The flight crew did not have a lot of English but enough to get by. Pillows and blankets for all passengers.
reviews.author: Joy F

reviews.title: Flying Out from Changsa to Wenzhou
reviews.text: Juneyao to my rescue after being let down by SCAir. If not for Juneyao I would have wasted 24 unproductive hours in Changsa. Totally disappointed with Southern China for their last minute cancellation.
reviews.author: KL Chong

reviews.title: First flight with Juneyao
reviews.text: The check in at the airport was fast and professional. In the plane was the legroom small and the food poor, the bun was old and hart.
reviews.author: pepeto

reviews.title: Efficient Domestic Flight
reviews.text: Good domestic flight from Shenzhen to Shanghai, lucky to not experience any delay. Generally good service.
reviews.author: leeoscar68

reviews.title: Guilin to Shanghai
reviews.text: We booked with Juneyao Air for our trip from Guilin-Shanghai. I booked for a Business Class Window Seat. The Business class lounge at Guilin Airport is a very comfortable medium size lounge with refreshments such as water, milk, tea and nice variety of biscuits. The Large purple colour business class window seat was comfortable and we were provided with blanket and cushion. The Cushioned slippers offered were very comfy. Dinner meal was served with two choices, Chicken or beef with a side of rice. The bowl of fruits was very cool and the slices tasted sweet. I had Waxberry juice (chines strawberry) as my drink. SEE photos.
reviews.author: Ghadeer

reviews.title: Staff was extremely rude.
reviews.text: To make it clear, I was not able to take the flight due to the lack of a boarding pass and my time of arrival at the airport. I understand that things were already setting me up for failure when it came to taking this flight, but I must share my experience so that others are aware of the culture that this airline has created among its team members. I ran out of my hotel to see if I could take an early morning flight so that I would not miss my friend's wedding in Taiwan. As previously mentioned, I knew all these things were standing against me already, but I still had some hope inside of me. As I arrived, I realized that this was not going to happen, especially with the way that the receptionist treated me as soon as she saw me, and I shared a little of my story with her. I had missed my flight the night before, which was the first time something like this had happened to me. I had a tough night, but I arrived at the airline with hopes that if I arrived at 8:10 am, I could run through everything to make it to the boarding 8:40 time and make it before the 8:55 departure. I jumped out of bed that morning, but the way this young woman treated me was beyond anything I have ever experienced. She talked to me as if I was an idiot and pointed at the flight ticket sales area, and without fully listening or speaking to her manager before sending me away, told me that it was impossible and to "go, go, go buy new ticket !!!" I respect the people and culture, and as a student, I am aware of the culture difference, but the way she looked at me and the face she gave me is something that I need to describe. She looked full of intolerance and arrogance. As I started crying with frustration, tiredness, and confusion, I asked her if I could speak to her manager because the time that I was there arguing with her could be enough time to help me find a solution and maybe make it into that flight. With an arrogant look and smirk on her face, she said: "Yeah, wait." At that point, I understood what I was going through. I realized that this young woman did not care, and no matter what I said or did, she will not do anything to help me. I gave up on the idea of miraculously making it into this flight and waited there for almost 25-30 minutes until her supervisor came to talk to me. I must share that this same supervisor was right next to her having a morning huddle with his team, while he was listening to her and I talk (me crying), so I told him that no matter what had happened, that I was going to let it go and just find a solution for my issue but that it was a shame that he could have stopped what he was doing and could have gotten involved in my situation. Especially because I was the only customer there at that moment. He apologized so many times and tried to do something, but it was too late.
reviews.author: MissBee

reviews.title: Only flight available
reviews.text: This is a difficult flight to book, especially in English. No access online and difficult to check in on line. Only problem, it’s the only airline that services this route. Once on board, staff were friendly and helpful, although I thought the food was very average
reviews.author: Chris P

reviews.title: Yes they do exist!!
reviews.text: Juneyao Airlines is a relatively new airline who are part of the Star Alliance group. (Yes, I had to google them before I booked flights to see if they existed- they do!!) We paid $300USD for a flight from Osaka to Helsinki, which included a 4 hour transit in Shanghai from 9pm-1am. The transit was VERY unorganised and nobody knew what was going on despite the fact that the staff had signs with our names on?! I’m still rating it 5* as I was very impressed with their inflight entertainment and food service considering it is a budget airline.
reviews.author: Charlotte M

reviews.title: Nice airlines
reviews.text: We had a pleasant flight, even we read about a lot of difficulties according to this airlines. It was much better, then we expected. The stuff was nice and helpful, check-in was easy and the flight arrived on time. The only problem was that when I tried to reach the call center for some informationt, I couldn't because it said that they have english assistant only between 8 AM and 8 PM, that was quite disapponting as the website of the airlines says they are vailable 24*7!
reviews.author: Kralovánszky K

reviews.title: Skilled pilots, super safe flight and good vibe
reviews.text: There are few times, when I have felt better on flight. Flew with them 4 flight and here’s what I can say: They really take safety as a main priority, they have super skilled pilots ( were able to land in heavy storm on a runway between mountains ). Their cabin crew is professional and funny, but the main thing is the vibe - relaxing and safe. I have flown with Finnair and Lufthansa, but honestly would choose them any time, they are just super safe and amazing airline. Have a good trip ;)
reviews.author: Henry

reviews.title: Snobbish attendant doesn't speak English, gave us ugly look, instead
reviews.text: Most of staff was rude and impolite. Is this a standard level in China ? Especially, one attendant spoke to us in Chinese and I asked what she said in English. She rolled her eyes and showed us disgusted look. Non English speaker is on board to Europe arrogantly ? Besides, Shang hai airport has "Transit counter", but practically does't exist. Transit passengers also have to exit and re-enter : each time getting inspection.How inefficient. In addition, an unprofessional inspector wasted our time. I'll never choose this company.
reviews.author: yoshirinyoshi

reviews.title: This airline actually exists!
reviews.text: When I booked the ticket I kind of thought it was a scam, never heard of this airline before, turns out, they actually exist. I had a good experience with them, staff was friendly on ground and in aircraft. To me it seemed they knew what they were doing. Down (or rather, sad) side is the amount of plastic used for meals. This, and the fact that I am vegan, mean I never eat the meals provided. However if I would, I would probably be missing more options. I lost my bag of provisions (or so I thought) and they guided me back to the gate, always smiling. The guy had a very natural sense of humour and all of them seemed quite relaxed. Prior to flight I called their hotline (phone number was a bit tough to find...) and the lady spoke sufficient English and her information regarding extra luggage was correct, so there were no surprises.
reviews.author: Daniel J

reviews.title: Could be so much more
reviews.text: First time with the airline and knew they were a budget airline, although for the pricy business class ticket thought I’d get more. Drink - cheap wine, Japanese beer (on a Chinese airline), juice, soda, tea/coffee. Not such a big choice. Meal - HOT DOG and Fruit - WOW!! Shocked - dry, no sauce to accompany it - but what are they thinking. Service team were pretty good and can’t fault them on safety, as after two attempts to land in extreme winds, the pilot took us back to Shanghai - free rebooking / refund choice provided. But then they could have seen that Typhoon coming!!!
reviews.author: LeprechaunWhispers

reviews.title: New Route Excellent baggage allowance
reviews.text: This is a new airline which offer direct flight from Singapore to Shanghai. A great addition because the check-in baggage allowance is very ideal. 23kg x 2. need to travel for a work trip and the booking was made last minute. the other airlines were either too over-priced or I had to transit. Meals served too.
reviews.author: viennamei

reviews.title: Avoid this airline
reviews.text: The worst airline i have ever take. There is no service at all during the flight or on ground. Food is disappointing, some basic amenities such as tissue are not provided, served cold bread and meal. Attendants unfriendly and transit in pvg can be a nightmare.
reviews.author: Andy Y

reviews.title: 8 top things you should know about Juneyao flight (family, time,food...)
reviews.text: It's my 2nd time to fly with Juneyao with my family (wife and daughter), we all enjoyed it, of course, some somethings could be done better, but they have just started so will give them that. Below better review: Check-in; was fast and nicely divided into groups (priority tickets, business class and family with small kid can go first. Seats: very comfortable and new. Food; have to say, there needs to be a big improvement with the food options because I even brought my own food with me like the one on the plane is just so so. Cleaning: the plane was clean, did not find anything in this category. Staff: Nice and friendly, took extra attention to my child and the safety. Oad thing was that we waited in Helsinki for 1,5 hours and still do not know the reason. Entertainment: adults there are ok distractions, but need more things for a small child Flight-time: for a family of small children the times are perfect because the child will be sleeping during the flight. Website: the website needs a big boost on the user-friendliness, especially my account and purchases ticket options. Till they update, it suggests using a 3rd party website to buy the ticket.
reviews.author: Kari Hakala

reviews.title: No communication between Ground Staff & Plane
reviews.text: So second time to experience their cancelled flight and it's only my 4th time flying them. Flight cancelled few hours before nobody was at the counter at airport until 2 hours before flight and was only 1 staff who only stayed a few minutes. Since they cancelled they should been handling flight reschedules but not even their customer care email and service lines work. all they said was to reschedule with the booking company and that's that, had to wait 2 days for my next flight. They not caring about passengers flight reschedules is pretty bad. So just got off my rescheduled flight, and as I expected we got delayed over an hour and the delayed notice only showed up when it was suppose to be boarding time, but the plane was nowhere insight. Cabin Crew looked totally overworked eyes closing and just doing their job so that They could get home the Guy attendant was talking to people with a slight attitude can't blame.him he looked like he hadn't slept for days. Seats and legroom for budget airline is good thou but I'm never flying them.
reviews.author: Shannon

reviews.title: low cost but ok
reviews.text: I flew BKK - Deagu round trip. Not special but for the price really ok. The Airplane was clean. there was no service was no but at this price and level no need.
reviews.author: schulte_bkk

reviews.title: Short flightb
reviews.text: A late flightb, but left on time , food serv d was good , dinner and breakfast , service was also very good and quite comfortable, I would fly this airline again
reviews.author: georgina b

reviews.title: More than I expected
reviews.text: A solid airline who did well dealing with English speaking pax. I have a special diet which was handled well. Plane was old with no TV set for an approx 3 hour flight. Would likely fly again.
reviews.author: tsaes

reviews.title: Best domestic airline of China
reviews.text: I have used all domestic airlines in China and have to say Juneyao airline is the best airline when you travel in China. A plane was clean and has a enough leg space. Staff on board were ver helpful and friendly. All of them had a good English skill. Snack provided on board was good. Most importantly, there was no delay at all. Some domestic airlines in China are notorious for frequent delay without a proper explanation. What a pleasant flight my family had. Thank you!
reviews.author: KimPeters

reviews.title: A pleasant, comfortable flight
reviews.text: A very satisfactory experience - new, clean aircraft, pleasant crew, timely flight. I used this airline both for the flight from Zhangjiajie to Shanghai and then from Shanghai to Gulin, and both experiences were equally pleasant. The checking in was beyond par, but that had nothing to do with the airline but with the airport bureaucracy.
reviews.author: worldnomad_01

reviews.title: New air craft. Dreamliner
reviews.text: Was worried about taking this airline as u have never heard of it. Price is surprising lower than the usual commercial airline. I had the dreamliner which is again surprised n pleasant. Only issue is that whole cabin full of mainland china passengers so they are not the most quiet ppl. Service was average.
reviews.author: May Lan T

reviews.title: Very good and reasonable choice for domestic flights
reviews.text: We had a domestic flight with June Airlines. During the booking process is wasnt sure if this is best choice because normally the Eastern and Southern China Air is more known. But i have to say that June Air is a very good airline and offers much more better pricing. The service was good (boarding, food, drinks). They did a professional job and the aircraft was new (A320). So i recommend this airline for doestic flights.
reviews.author: stephankern

reviews.title: Smooth flight
reviews.text: Busy flight but reasonably comfortable and on time. There was a meal provided, not expected, which could have been a bit better. A drink was also provided. Fairly average for a budget flight. Staff were all very friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: itchyfeet2014

reviews.title: Budget Airline to Shanghai
reviews.text: I would consider Juneyao airline a budget airline based in Shanghai. There is no audio visual entertainment on-flight. Unlike others of the same kind, free check-in luggage (20kg) and meal (don't expect much) are included. The downside is that its departure of both inbound and outbound flights are at nighttime or near midnight, making it cheaper than other ordinary flight. I took a flight departing HKG at 10:00pm and arriving at PVG 1:00am and left the airport at nearly 2:00am that was, no doubt, quite late to everyone. Sidetracked a bit, there is accommodation within PVG terminal building.
reviews.author: Alvin M

reviews.title: a long-short flight
reviews.text: I flew with Juneyao airlines between Shanghai and Changchun. It is a domestic flight of 2.5 hours but for China distances is a flight equivalent to a distance from South to North of Europe. The airliner was a 3-3 seats body, the staff was polite as is usually the case with Chinese airliners. It had a minor delay but it was due to traffic control in the departure. Check in in Changchun was OK but with minimal English from the ground staff. Clean plane, cozy seats, nothing to complain.
reviews.author: Sofi NS

reviews.title: Good budget airline
reviews.text: Very nice budget airline. Space in economy isnt bad, personnel is friendly and kind. Check in was flawless and the flight arrived on the promised time. Even got a small meal which was nice and tasted better than some other airplane food. Good tot a short cheap flight.
reviews.author: D13O

reviews.title: Standard flight
reviews.text: Plane was great, clean and in good condition. Cabin crew were friendly and helpful. Surprisingly, the snacks on our flight were pretty good for Chinese airline and Western palate. Leg room always a bit tight in China
reviews.author: Chris P

reviews.title: One hour delayed arrival in BKK at 2 AM is not what you want with another working day luring.
reviews.text: We actually boarded on time for a flight ETA BKK 1AM but ended up actually arriving one hour late. Having an early morning the next day was hard. On top the seats on board 1317 were extremely hard and relaxing not possible during flight.
reviews.author: Hinze1962

reviews.title: Definitely NOT star alliance connecting partner
reviews.text: Definitely not star alliance connecting partner as I had a through ticket from Lufthansa connecting with Juneyao. As a gold member; connecting with Juneyao there was no priority service, no extra baggage, no lounge access and worst of all, no frills. Do not for a second believe that this is a star alliance connecting flight or partner as they have no clue what’s going on. First and last Time. Btw, the plane was delayed for 2 hours and nothing was offered. Poor service, no priority for gold members and poor equipment. No more Juneyao. They should be kicked out of the alliance as a connecting partner.
reviews.author: TWLau

reviews.title: Good flight, average airline
reviews.text: I've know flown this segment in business class and also in economy; biz class was a "no frills" flight, economy flight seems to be just the same w/o having any infotainment systems available. The late evening meal (flight originated at 9.25pm), was rather bland and bleak. If I had to pay for this flight I would have chosen another airline, however it was part of a United MilePlus rewards flight.
reviews.author: Eat, drink and travel

reviews.title: Good Flight. Easy and smooth
reviews.text: Flew from Shanghai to Bangkok. Flight was smooth and service was good. The flight is cheap so you get what you pay for on a budget airline. NO Tvs on seat but thats what sleep is for. Lights didnt turn off during flight at night. No real complaints. Didnt want to pay for big name 3x the price. They all do the same thing, fly to where you want to go.
reviews.author: William H

reviews.title: Family China trip
reviews.text: Fantastic very kind and treated us well. Happy to travel again. We enjoyed our flight and traveling around in china we flew with company twice. We had no problem with bag drop or check in.
reviews.author: Margaret A

reviews.title: An excelent   China domestic airline
reviews.text: An excelent , unexpensive , with all sevice items included in final price, all with excelent service. The value of the free meal they serve only is likely to be higher than the western airlines charge passengers as rate for trip serving nothing other than a random seat on the flight
reviews.author: amalzyner

reviews.title: Nothing to get excited about
reviews.text: This was my first flight with this airline, booked for me, and 3 words come to mind - average, average and average. We took off on time, flew in a pretty straight line and arrived on time. The plane was modern, clean and equipped as you would expect for a budget airline. The flight left at 1.50 am from Bangkok so I didn't expect any food service but they surprised me at around 5.30am with an unimaginative snack pack. We were landing around 6.30 so I think this was just a way to get everybody awake. Coming from Thailand, the land of smiles, the comparison to the lack of Chinese smiles was starkly apparent. Everything was done is an efficient and poker face way. I wouldn't choose this airline personally compared to Xiamen or China Eastern but it's OK. 3 words really
reviews.author: Instantcalmer

reviews.title: Extremely poor to non existent customser service. I would not reccomend.
reviews.text: We initially tried to book flights online. I gave my credit card details , then the page froze and no flight confirmation was given. The flight was not booked but my credit card was charged. We had to book again with a different card and this worked. Prior to catching our flight, I send several emails and overseas phone calls asking for a refund, however, I was unsuccessful in getting a response from anyone from june yao. I received no response via email and while placed on hold over the phone, someone would hang up on me every time. On the day of our departure, I spoke to someone in person at the June Yao customer service desk. Showed them receipts and proof of transaction and they were able to look it up and confirm that we were charged twice for the one set of flights. I was told that the refund was processed and I would expect it to arrive in 5-7 business days. Its been 1 month since then and yet still no refund. I have miraculously been able to contact someone over the phone now and I am still battling with getting my refund back. I have had to explain my story more then 3 times and show proof. Not once in my entire communication with June yao (which has been little) have I received any empathy or apology. Their service is unprofessional and has poor lines of communication. I would strongly avoid this airline. After this horrendous experience I would not reccomend it to anyone.
